::: callout-tip
## Recommendation

By default, we suggest downloading the *.csv* file. If the user aims to use *CropMED* for spatial analysis under GIS workflows, we suggest downloading the *.gpkg* version
:::

## Download links

- [Download the main dataset (*Comma-Separated Values* file)](https://zenodo.org/records/20717354/files/CropMED_dataset.csv?download=1) (7.2 MB)

- [Download the geographic dataset (*GeoPackage* file)](https://zenodo.org/records/20717354/files/CropMED_dataset_geoms.gpkg?download=1) (642.5MB)
